StoreTransactionDoc.title: StoreTransactionDoc
StoreTransactionDoc.description: Cloud-synchronized retail POS bill transaction for New Farm Product.

userId.description: Authenticated Google UID of the store account.

staffId.description: Staff profile ID who recorded the bill.

staffName.description: Display name of the staff member.

lineCount.description: Number of distinct product lines in the bill.

itemsSummary.description: Compact summary of items sold and price snapshots.

paymentMethod.description: Payment mode used for the bill.

isRepeatCustomer.description: True if this bill belongs to a repeat customer in the same visit.

cancellationReason.description: Optional reason when status is CANCELLED.

saleEpochMillis.description: Local epoch timestamp when the sale occurred.

StoreVisitorDoc.title: StoreVisitorDoc
StoreVisitorDoc.description: Cloud-synchronized visitor counter event for New Farm Product.

userId.description: Authenticated Google UID of the store account.

delta.description: +1 for visitor arrival or -1 for audited correction.

staffId.description: Staff ID who logged the visitor count.

eventEpochMillis.description: Local epoch timestamp when visitor was logged.

StoreFreezerSectionDoc.title: StoreFreezerSectionDoc
StoreFreezerSectionDoc.description: Cloud-synchronized freezer section mapping and metadata forFreezers 1 to 7.

userId.description: Authenticated Google UID of the store account.

sectionCode.description: Section code such as Section A, Section B, Section C, Section D.

mappedProducts.description: Comma-separated or searchable list of products in this section.

manualNotes.description: Manual placement notes entered by staff.

updatedByStaffName.description: Name of the staff member who last updated this section.

updatedEpochMillis.description: Local epoch timestamp of the section update.

StoreProductDoc.title: StoreProductDoc
StoreProductDoc.description: Cloud-synchronized product rate and catalogue record.

userId.description: Authenticated Google UID of the store account.

isRateConfigured.description: True if the selling rate has been explicitly set by the Owner.

isActive.description: Whether the product is active for POS billing.

StoreAuditLogDoc.title: StoreAuditLogDoc
StoreAuditLogDoc.description: Immutable cloud audit log for financial and inventory actions.

userId.description: Authenticated Google UID of the store account.

/users/{userId}/store_transactions/{tran.description: Cloud-synced POS bills scoped to the authenticated store account.

/users/{userId}/store_visitors/{visitorI.description: Cloud-synced visitor logs scoped to the authenticated store account.

/users/{userId}/store_freezers/{sectionI.description: Cloud-synced 7-freezer section records scoped to the authenticated store account.

/users/{userId}/store_products/{productI.description: Cloud-synced product rates scoped to the authenticated store account.

/users/{userId}/store_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Cloud-synced audit trail scoped to the authenticated store account.
